stage.name: Opening Act
stage.description:
Getting that first win is crucial for any team. Work together and win your first game!
<Mercy Rule> First team to get a 5-goal lead wins.

rioter.name: Rioter
rioter.flavourText: An enemy combatant of unknown identity. They are often found wherever there is turmoil and unrest. They wear a face mask to conceal their identity and use haphazardly-made weapons to engage in melee combat.

parade_balloon.name: Parade Balloon
parade_balloon.flavourText: One of the balloons released during the parade. Makes a loud bang when pierced—though it's not a gun, it can still make the crowd go wild.
abilities: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
Restores a large amount of HP to 'Firework Launcher' when defeated during Carnevale

entusiasta_lead_dancer.name: Entusiasta Lead Dancer
entusiasta_lead_dancer.flavourText: The lead dancer from a troupe invited by big companies to liven up Carnevale. Her skirt flickers like flame, warming the crowd and setting the streets ablaze—literally!
abilities: Invisible
Continuously deals Arts damage and Burn for the skill duration, Attack Range increases when Invisibility is lost
Loses Invisibility during Carnevale

cocktail_thrower.name: Cocktail Thrower
cocktail_thrower.flavourText: An enemy combatant of unknown identity. They wear a face mask to conceal their identity, and use Molotov cocktails to deal damage within a range. These weapons are usually associated with riots.

parading_jazz_musician.name: Parading Jazz Musician
parading_jazz_musician.flavourText: A musician in festive garb who's part of the parade. He's gotten pretty good with his instrument, and he knows when best to get the crowd going.
abilities: Invisible, normally does not attack, but counters when losing Invisibility
Continuously deals Arts damage and Burn for the skill duration
Loses Invisibility during Carnevale

gourmet_delivery.name: 'Gourmet Delivery'
gourmet_delivery.flavourText: A food delivery truck plying the streets, busier as Carnevale approaches. The chef looks different today—like someone from a wanted poster. What’s he really delivering?
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 3 Block, and deals Physical damage by colliding with player's units
Takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage; loses damage reduction during Carnevale

merrymaker_express.name: 'Merrymaker Express'
merrymaker_express.flavourText: A large truck spraying beer over the masses from within the parade at the behest of corporations. The crowd goes wild, and order slowly collapses. Now it's a real party.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage; loses damage reduction during Carnevale
After charging for some time, deals Physical damage to a target and all surrounding allied units, and temporarily lowers maximum Block; this attack can weaken flames

compressed_ball.name: Compressed Ball
compressed_ball.flavourText: A football made from compressed building materials to enrich the match experience. 'Heavy' doesn't begin to describe it. Do your foot a favor and don't bother kicking it.
abilities: A heavy football that is hard to move.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

fluffy_pink_balloon.name: Fluffy Pink Balloon
fluffy_pink_balloon.flavourText: A football that imitates a furry critter to enrich the match experience... Hey, where did it go? Okay, it's actually a real furry critter that's drifting through the air right now.
abilities: A very light football that can be easily moved.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

originite_prime_ball.name: Originite Prime Ball
originite_prime_ball.flavourText: A football that looks like Originite Prime to enrich the match experience. Not actual Originium, so it is perfectly safe and does not explode.
abilities: Gives 3x score.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

perpetual_rebounder.name: Perpetual Rebounder
perpetual_rebounder.flavourText: A football inspired by an extremely unstable entity to enrich the match experience. It is as unpredictable as its inspiration, and has already been bouncing all over the field for half an hour... Somebody stop it, please!
abilities: A very bouncy football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

rma70_spikeball.name: RMA70 Spikeball
rma70_spikeball.flavourText: A football that imitates RMA70 minerals to enrich the match experience. Its spikes are surprisingly benign. Players who have tried it say that kicking it is a highly interactive experience.
abilities: A standard football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
